nameplate_source: IEK AIR56B2 passport/catalog data confirmed for the target motor by the operator
measurement_note: This profile is for MCSDK ACIM V/F open-loop preparation. The physical motor is connected in Delta to a 220 V line-to-line inverter. MCSDK uses the star-equivalent 127.017 V phase-to-neutral model. Rs/Rr/Lls/Llr/Lm/inertia are intentionally absent: they must be measured before FOC/identification or any high-voltage release.
